@@ -0,0 +1,1299 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# ablation-grade.sh — the cycle-130 ablation grader (SDD §3.6, §5.7, D-4.7, D-4.8;
+# PRD FR-6 AC-6.1/6.2/6.4; DEC-0401, DEC-0413, DEC-0414, DEC-0420, DEC-0491, DEC-0493)
+#
+# Grades ONE run directory written by pipeline-run.sh against its task and writes
+# grade.json (the input ablation-row.sh joins into the runs.jsonl row), or
+# self-checks a task (--self-check) on a synthetic run built from the task itself.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   ablation-grade.sh <run-dir> <task-id> [--suite-root DIR] [--tasks-dir tasks|smoke]
+#                     [--out FILE] [--json] [--executor container|host]
+#                     [--image loa-ablation:258] [--docker-bin D]
+#                     [--allow-unfrozen] [--allow-partial]
+#   ablation-grade.sh --self-check base|reference|noisy --task-yaml F [--suite-root DIR]
+#                     [--executor …] [--image …] [--docker-bin D] [--json]
+#                     [--allow-unfrozen] [--allow-partial]
+#
+# Options:
+#   --suite-root DIR   suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0; with
+#                      --self-check, the directory two levels above the task dir)
+#   --tasks-dir T      tasks (default) or smoke: the task is <root>/<T>/<task-id>/
+#   --out FILE         where grade.json goes (default <run-dir>/grade.json)
+#   --json             also print grade.json (self-check: the verdict object) on stdout
+#   --executor MODE    container (default; DEC-0491) or host
+#   --image IMG        the grading image (default loa-ablation:258)
+#   --docker-bin D     docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
+#   --allow-unfrozen   grade although freeze.sh --check fails or the suite has no
+#                      MANIFEST.sha256 yet (task authoring only); grade.json records
+#                      suite_frozen: false. Without it a drift is exit 2 (DEC-0414).
+#   --allow-partial    passed to freeze.sh --check (fewer than four tasks per type)
+#   --self-check MODE  base | reference | noisy (noisy: review-catch only), see below
+#   --task-yaml F      the task to self-check (<root>/<tasks|smoke>/<id>/task.yaml)
+#
+# Reads ONLY (DEC-0413): <run-dir>/sandbox/, <run-dir>/snapshots/{index.json,<LABEL>.bundle},
+# <run-dir>/transcripts/events-*.jsonl, <run-dir>/eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json,
+# the task's directory under the suite root (task.yaml, hidden/, fixture/), the suite's
+# MANIFEST.sha256 (through freeze.sh) and, for review-catch, the key manifest the task
+# names (review_catch.manifest) and its PR fixture (self-check only). It never reads
+# <run-dir>/meta/, the batch MANIFEST.json, or the sandbox copies of the dissent
+# envelopes (tamperable; the harness copies under eval/ are authoritative). It writes
+# only <run-dir>/grading/ and the --out file; nothing under sandbox/ is ever written.
+#
+# Freeze: freeze.sh --check --root <suite-root> runs first (with --smoke when the
+# suite manifest lists smoke/ paths, so a manifest frozen with --smoke checks as it
+# was frozen); a drift or a missing manifest refuses the grade (exit 2) unless
+# --allow-unfrozen.
+#
+# Grading trees (D-4.8) under <run-dir>/grading/<label>/, recreated on every call:
+#   final      sandbox/ as the agent left it, minus the top-level .git .claude CLAUDE.md
+#              .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run .beads .eval pr, every __pycache__ and
+#              .pytest_cache, and anything that is not a regular file, directory or
+#              symlink (a FIFO never blocks the copy)
+#   implement  the IMPLEMENT snapshot (snapshots/IMPLEMENT.bundle, commit
+#              index.json.implement): the tree REVIEW read; graded when REVIEW ran or
+#              when AUDIT ran without a fix1 snapshot
+#   fix1       the FIX1 snapshot: the tree AUDIT read; graded when AUDIT ran
+#   base       the task fixture: the baseline for regression_command (and, refactor,
+#              the suite-green-at-base check)
+# A snapshot is extracted with `git bundle unbundle` into a scratch bare repository and
+# `git archive <commit>` (a member that would land outside the tree is skipped). In
+# every tree each grader_protected path is restored from the fixture (a deleted file is
+# recreated, a modified one overwritten, a path the fixture lacks is removed; a
+# symlinked parent is replaced by a directory), then every hidden/manifest.json entry
+# is written at its dest (a same-named file is overwritten, a deleted directory

+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ small helpers
+def run(cmd, **kw):

+
+def load_yaml(path):

+
+def is_within(path, root):

+def remove_path(p):

+def safe_rel(rel):
+    if not isinstance(rel, str) or not rel or rel.startswith("/") or "\\" in rel:
+        return None
+    parts = [x for x in rel.split("/") if x not in ("", ".")]
+    if not parts or ".." in parts:

+
+
+def ensure_parent(tree, parts):
+    """make every parent component of tree/parts a real directory inside tree"""
+    cur = tree
+    for comp in parts[:-1]:
+        cur = os.path.join(cur, comp)
+        if os.path.islink(cur) or (os.path.lexists(cur) and not os.path.isdir(cur)):
+            os.unlink(cur)
+        if not os.path.isdir(cur):

+def copy_tree(src, dst, top_exclude=frozenset()):
+    """regular files, directories and symlinks only; caches dropped"""

+        rel = os.path.relpath(root, src)
+        keep = []
+        for d in sorted(dirs):
+            if (rel == "." and d in top_exclude) or d in EXCLUDE_ANY:
+                continue
+            sp = os.path.join(root, d)
+            dp = os.path.join(dst, rel, d)
+            if os.path.islink(sp):
+                os.symlink(os.readlink(sp), dp)
+                continue
+            os.makedirs(dp, exist_ok=True)
+            keep.append(d)
+        dirs[:] = keep
+        for f in sorted(files):
+            if rel == "." and f in top_exclude:
+                continue

+    parts = safe_rel(rel)
+    if parts is None:

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# =============================================================================
+# ablation-grade.sh — the cycle-130 ablation grader (SDD §3.6, §5.7, D-4.7, D-4.8;
+# PRD FR-6 AC-6.1/6.2/6.4; DEC-0401, DEC-0413, DEC-0414, DEC-0420, DEC-0491, DEC-0493)
+#
+# Grades ONE run directory written by pipeline-run.sh against its task and writes
+# grade.json (the input ablation-row.sh joins into the runs.jsonl row), or
+# self-checks a task (--self-check) on a synthetic run built from the task itself.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   ablation-grade.sh <run-dir> <task-id> [--suite-root DIR] [--tasks-dir tasks|smoke]
+#                     [--out FILE] [--json] [--executor container|host]
+#                     [--image loa-ablation:258] [--docker-bin D]
+#                     [--allow-unfrozen] [--allow-partial]
+#   ablation-grade.sh --self-check base|reference|noisy --task-yaml F [--suite-root DIR]
+#                     [--executor …] [--image …] [--docker-bin D] [--json]
+#                     [--allow-unfrozen] [--allow-partial]
+#
+# Options:
+#   --suite-root DIR   suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0; with
+#                      --self-check, the directory two levels above the task dir)
+#   --tasks-dir T      tasks (default) or smoke: the task is <root>/<T>/<task-id>/
+#   --out FILE         where grade.json goes (default <run-dir>/grade.json)
+#   --json             also print grade.json (self-check: the verdict object) on stdout
+#   --executor MODE    container (default; DEC-0491) or host
+#   --image IMG        the grading image (default loa-ablation:258)
+#   --docker-bin D     docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
+#   --allow-unfrozen   grade although freeze.sh --check fails or the suite has no
+#                      MANIFEST.sha256 yet (task authoring only); grade.json records
+#                      suite_frozen: false. Without it a drift is exit 2 (DEC-0414).
+#   --allow-partial    passed to freeze.sh --check (fewer than four tasks per type)
+#   --self-check MODE  base | reference | noisy (noisy: review-catch only), see below
+#   --task-yaml F      the task to self-check (<root>/<tasks|smoke>/<id>/task.yaml)
+#
+# Reads ONLY (DEC-0413): <run-dir>/sandbox/, <run-dir>/snapshots/{index.json,<LABEL>.bundle},
+# <run-dir>/transcripts/events-*.jsonl, <run-dir>/eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json,
+# the task's directory under the suite root (task.yaml, hidden/, fixture/), the suite's
+# MANIFEST.sha256 (through freeze.sh) and, for review-catch, the key manifest the task
+# names (review_catch.manifest) and its PR fixture (self-check only). It never reads
+# <run-dir>/meta/, the batch MANIFEST.json, or the sandbox copies of the dissent
+# envelopes (tamperable; the harness copies under eval/ are authoritative). It writes
+# only <run-dir>/grading/ and the --out file; nothing under sandbox/ is ever written.
+#
+# Freeze: freeze.sh --check --root <suite-root> runs first (with --smoke when the
+# suite manifest lists smoke/ paths, so a manifest frozen with --smoke checks as it
+# was frozen); a drift or a missing manifest refuses the grade (exit 2) unless
+# --allow-unfrozen.
+#
+# Grading trees (D-4.8) under <run-dir>/grading/<label>/, recreated on every call:
+#   final      sandbox/ as the agent left it, minus the top-level .git .claude CLAUDE.md
+#              .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run .beads .eval pr, every __pycache__ and
+#              .pytest_cache, and anything that is not a regular file, directory or
+#              symlink (a FIFO never blocks the copy)
+#   implement  the IMPLEMENT snapshot (snapshots/IMPLEMENT.bundle, commit
+#              index.json.implement): the tree REVIEW read; graded when REVIEW ran or
+#              when AUDIT ran without a fix1 snapshot
+#   fix1       the FIX1 snapshot: the tree AUDIT read; graded when AUDIT ran
+#   base       the task fixture: the baseline for regression_command (and, refactor,
+#              the suite-green-at-base check)
+# A snapshot is extracted with `git bundle unbundle` into a scratch bare repository and
+# `git archive <commit>` (a member that would land outside the tree is skipped). In
+# every tree each grader_protected path is restored from the fixture (a deleted file is
+# recreated, a modified one overwritten, a path the fixture lacks is removed; a
+# symlinked parent is replaced by a directory), then every hidden/manifest.json entry
+# is written at its dest (a same-named file is overwritten, a deleted directory
+# recreated). Churn (diff_lines, files_changed) compares the final tree against the
+# fixture before any restore: added + removed lines per changed text file (difflib),
+# every added, removed or modified file counted once; null for review-catch.
+#
+# Commands run INSIDE the image (DEC-0491):
+#   docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=256m --user <uid>:<gid>
+#     -v <tree>:/workspace:rw -w /workspace -e HOME=/tmp -e LC_ALL=C -e TMPDIR=/tmp
+#     <image> timeout 120 <cmd…>
+# `python3 -m pytest …` (or `pytest …`) becomes `python3 -I -s -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider
+# -q --rootdir /workspace -rA …` (one -q: -qq would drop the summary line; -rA lists every
+# outcome, from which the ids come); `bats …` becomes `bats --tap …` with BATS_LIB_PATH
+# unset (the -e set is the whole container environment). --executor host runs the same
+# argv in the tree under `env -i PATH HOME=<scratch> LC_ALL=C TMPDIR=<scratch>
+# PYTHONUSERBASE=<the caller's user base>` with pytest as `python3 -P -m pytest …`:
+# no -I or -s on the host, because the host's pytest lives in the user site (the Sprint
+# 258 smoke found no pytest under `-I -s`); PYTHONUSERBASE is passed for the same reason.
+#
+# Parsing: the pytest summary line (`N passed, M failed, K error …`) or TAP (`1..N`,
+# `ok`/`not ok`). A collection error is expanded to the test functions of its file; the
+# hidden total is never below the static case count of the hidden test files (`def test`
+# / `@test`). A command without a parseable summary counts total = that static count
+# (at least 1), passed = 0 when it exited non-zero (total when it exited 0), with
+# parse_error: true. Ids: "t<k>", k = the 1-based position of the case in file order
+# (pytest: path, then the line of its def; TAP: the test number); regression ids are
+# positions in the base run, newly_failing = failing at final, passing at base.
+#
+# Review-catch (DEC-0420): grading/gates-combined.md is the arm-neutral reduction: every
+# `path:line[-line]` citation (parser of recall-vs-defects.sh 1.1.2; the LOA-VERDICT
+# trailer removed first) from sandbox/review.md (the A0 contract),
+# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/{engineer-feedback.md,auditor-sprint-feedback.md}
+# and each finding's anchor (and file:line) in eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json,
+# one normalised `path:line[-line]` line each (pr/head/ → head/, a/ b/ and /workspace/
+# prefixes dropped), duplicates dropped. recall-vs-defects.sh <grading-dir> <pr-NN>
+# gates-combined.md (EVAL_MANIFEST_DIR = the manifest's directory) gives recall;
+# flags = its findings_cited; missed = defect positions ("d2"), never defect ids.
+# false_positives = citations within ±3 of no anchor, deduplicated by cited region
+# (same file, overlapping ±3 windows count once).
+#
+# Verdicts: the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` trailer of engineer-feedback.md (review)
+# and auditor-sprint-feedback.md (audit); a gate ran when its feedback file exists.
+# verdict = {source_file, value}: the audit's, else the review's, else review.md's
+# `Verdict:` line (A0), else null. verdict_accuracy_per_gate {review, audit}: build —
+# true when APPROVED and the tree that gate read passes every hidden test, or
+# CHANGES_REQUIRED and it fails one; review-catch — true iff (CHANGES_REQUIRED) ==
+# (the key holds a high or critical defect); a gate without a trailer is false; a gate
+# that did not run is null. verdict_accuracy = audit's, else review's, else null.
+#
+# Contamination (D-4.7, DEC-0493): every tool_use input in transcripts/events-*.jsonl —
+# Bash command; Read/Grep/Glob file_path|path|pattern; Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit
+# file_path|notebook_path; WebFetch url; WebSearch query — is checked for: `hidden` (any
+# case) → hidden; grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0 → suite_path; 0xHoneyJar/loa →
+# repo_name; `git log … --all` or `git reflog` (Bash) → git_history; an absolute path
+# (path fields, the Glob pattern, path-shaped Bash words; a one-component `/x/` word
+# is read as a regex) outside /workspace /tmp /home/evaluser /dev /proc /sys /usr /bin
+# /sbin /lib /lib64 /etc /opt /var (container), or outside the sandbox root (the
+# sessions' init cwd and <run-dir>/sandbox), /tmp, those system directories and the
+# caller's ~/.claude ~/.claude.json ~/.codex ~/.aws (host) → outside_path. The first hit
+# in phase order is contaminated: {phase, pattern, excerpt_id: "<phase>:<line>"} (never
+# the text); else null. The scan is a LOWER BOUND on leakage: obfuscated access, reads
+# by programs the agent wrote, and network access by other means are not seen.
+#
+# grade.json (ids only in every summary field: no test name, defect title or excerpt):
+#   {schema_version: 1, grader_version: "1.0.0", task_id, task_type, suite_frozen,
+#    executor_mode, image, snapshots_graded: [labels], hidden_tests {passed, total,
+#    failed_names, parse_error, timed_out}, structural (refactor: {passed, total,
+#    failed_names, parse_error, suite_green_base, suite_green_final}; else null),
+#    regressions ({newly_failing, base {passed, total}, final {passed, total}} or null
+#    without regression_command), snapshot_tests {implement?, fix1?: {passed, total}},
+#    recall (review-catch {defects_seeded, defects_caught, recall, flags, missed}; else
+#    null), false_positives, verdict, verdicts {review, audit}, verdict_accuracy,
+#    verdict_accuracy_per_gate {review, audit}, diff_lines, files_changed, contaminated}
+# No timestamp and no scratch path is written: the same run grades byte-identically.
+#
+# Self-check (DEC-0401; AC-2.3): a synthetic run under mktemp -d built from the task.
+#   base       build: the fixture is the final tree → PASS when at least one hidden test
+#              fails and the fixture suite (regression_command, when set) is green;
+#              refactor: structural check red and suite green; review-catch: an empty
+#              findings file → recall 0.0
+#   reference  build: the fixture with hidden/reference.patch (patch -p1) → every hidden
+#              test passes, suite green; refactor: structural green, suite green;
+#              review-catch: a findings file citing every key anchor → recall 1.0
+#   noisy      review-catch: every line of every pr/head/ file cited → false_positives
+#              greater than the reference findings file's
+# Prints `self-check <mode> <task-id>: PASS|FAIL <evidence>`.
+#
+# Exit codes: 0 graded / self-check PASS; 1 self-check FAIL; 2 error (usage, missing run
+# dir, task not found, unfrozen suite without --allow-unfrozen, docker or the image
+# missing in container mode, a tool failure).
+#
+# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-grade.bats (docker = evals/tests/fixtures/docker-stub.sh).
+# No .claude/ code is sourced and nothing is sourced or eval'd from a variable (eval.yml
+# trust boundary); hashing is Python hashlib.
+# =============================================================================
+set -euo pipefail
+export LC_ALL=C
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+case "${1:-}" in -h|--help) sed -n '3,/^# =====/p' "$0" | sed '$d' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 0 ;; esac
+
+exec python3 -I - "$SCRIPT_DIR" "$REPO_ROOT" "${EVAL_DOCKER_BIN:-docker}" "$@" <<'PY'
+import argparse, difflib, json, os, re, shutil, site, stat, subprocess, sys, tarfile, tempfile
+
+GRADER_VERSION = "1.0.0"
+SCRIPT_DIR, REPO_ROOT, DOCKER_DEFAULT = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
+SPRINT = "sprint-1"
+TEST_TIMEOUT_S = 120
+EXCLUDE_TOP = {".git", ".claude", "CLAUDE.md", ".loa.config.yaml", "grimoires", ".run", ".beads", ".eval", "pr"}
+EXCLUDE_ANY = {"__pycache__", ".pytest_cache"}
+PHASE_ORDER = ["PLAN", "BARE", "IMPLEMENT", "REVIEW", "FIX1", "AUDIT", "FIX2"]
+
+
+class GradeError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def die(msg):
+    print(f"ablation-grade: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
+    sys.exit(2)
+
+
+ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="ablation-grade.sh", add_help=False)
+ap.add_argument("run_dir", nargs="?")
+ap.add_argument("task_id", nargs="?")
+ap.add_argument("--suite-root")
+ap.add_argument("--tasks-dir", choices=["tasks", "smoke"])
+ap.add_argument("--out")
+ap.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
+ap.add_argument("--executor", choices=["container", "host"], default="container")
+ap.add_argument("--image", default="loa-ablation:258")
+ap.add_argument("--docker-bin", default=DOCKER_DEFAULT)
+ap.add_argument("--allow-unfrozen", action="store_true")
+ap.add_argument("--allow-partial", action="store_true")
+ap.add_argument("--self-check", choices=["base", "reference", "noisy"])
+ap.add_argument("--task-yaml")
+try:
+    A = ap.parse_args(sys.argv[4:])
+except SystemExit:
+    sys.exit(2)
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ small helpers
+def run(cmd, **kw):
+    return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, **kw)
+
+
+def load_yaml(path):
+    p = run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path])
+    if p.returncode != 0:
+        raise GradeError(f"task yaml does not parse: {path}")
+    try:
+        return json.loads(p.stdout)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise GradeError(f"task yaml does not parse: {path}")
+
+
+def read_json(path):
+    try:
+        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            return json.load(f)
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return None
+
+
+def is_within(path, root):
+    path, root = os.path.realpath(path), os.path.realpath(root)
+    return path == root or path.startswith(root + os.sep)
+
+
+def remove_path(p):
+    if os.path.islink(p) or os.path.isfile(p):
+        os.unlink(p)
+    elif os.path.isdir(p):
+        for r, ds, _fs in os.walk(p):
+            for d in ds:
+                try:
+                    os.chmod(os.path.join(r, d), 0o700)
+                except OSError:
+                    pass
+        shutil.rmtree(p)
+    elif os.path.lexists(p):
+        os.unlink(p)
+
+
+def safe_rel(rel):
+    if not isinstance(rel, str) or not rel or rel.startswith("/") or "\\" in rel:
+        return None
+    parts = [x for x in rel.split("/") if x not in ("", ".")]
+    if not parts or ".." in parts:
+        return None
+    return parts
+
+
+def ensure_parent(tree, parts):
+    """make every parent component of tree/parts a real directory inside tree"""
+    cur = tree
+    for comp in parts[:-1]:
+        cur = os.path.join(cur, comp)
+        if os.path.islink(cur) or (os.path.lexists(cur) and not os.path.isdir(cur)):
+            os.unlink(cur)
+        if not os.path.isdir(cur):
+            os.mkdir(cur)
+    return os.path.join(cur, parts[-1])
+
+
+def copy_tree(src, dst, top_exclude=frozenset()):
+    """regular files, directories and symlinks only; caches dropped"""
+    os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
+    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(src, followlinks=False):
+        rel = os.path.relpath(root, src)
+        keep = []
+        for d in sorted(dirs):
+            if (rel == "." and d in top_exclude) or d in EXCLUDE_ANY:
+                continue
+            sp = os.path.join(root, d)
+            dp = os.path.join(dst, rel, d)
+            if os.path.islink(sp):
+                os.symlink(os.readlink(sp), dp)
+                continue
+            os.makedirs(dp, exist_ok=True)
+            keep.append(d)
+        dirs[:] = keep
+        for f in sorted(files):
+            if rel == "." and f in top_exclude:
+                continue
+            sp, dp = os.path.join(root, f), os.path.join(dst, rel, f)
+            st = os.lstat(sp)
+            if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):
+                os.symlink(os.readlink(sp), dp)
+            elif stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
+                shutil.copyfile(sp, dp)
+                os.chmod(dp, (st.st_mode & 0o777) | 0o600)
+
+
+def put_file(tree, rel, src):
+    parts = safe_rel(rel)
+    if parts is None:
+        raise GradeError(f"unsafe path: {rel!r}")
+    dst = ensure_parent(tree, parts)
+    if os.path.lexists(dst):
+        remove_path(dst)
+    if os.path.isdir(src) and not os.path.islink(src):
+        copy_tree(src, dst)
+    else:
+        shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
+        os.chmod(dst, (os.stat(src).st_mode & 0o777) | 0o600)
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ task loading
+class Task:
+    pass
+
+
+def load_task(task_yaml, suite_root):
+    t = Task()
+    t.yaml = os.path.abspath(task_yaml)
+    t.dir = os.path.dirname(t.yaml)
+    t.suite_root = os.path.abspath(suite_root)
+    t.spec = load_yaml(t.yaml)
+    if not isinstance(t.spec, dict):

+              f"contaminated {g['contaminated']['pattern'] if g['contaminated'] else 'no'} → {out}")
+    return 0
+
+
+try:
+    rc = main()
+except GradeError as e:
+    print(f"ablation-grade: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
+    rc = 2
+except Exception as e:  # an unexpected shape is an error (2), never a self-check FAIL (1)
+    print(f"ablation-grade: internal error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
+    rc = 2
+finally:
+    try:
+        remove_path(SCRATCH)
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+sys.exit(rc)
+PY

+"""seed_tasks.py — the engine behind seed-bugfix-tasks.sh and seed-refactor-tasks.sh.
+
+cycle-130 Sprint 259 Tasks 2.2 / 2.3 (SDD §5.14). Run only through the two
+wrappers (they pass --repo-default and --no-secrets); the usage, options, output
+lines and exit codes are documented in the wrappers' header blocks.
+
+Stdlib only; run as `python3 -I`. Every git call is an argument vector (no
+shell), every path read from history is checked before it touches the disk, and
+a task is built in a private temporary directory and moved into place only after
+its proof passed and the no-secrets scan came back clean.
+"""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import site
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+
+MOUNT_OWNED = (".claude", "CLAUDE.md", ".loa.config.yaml", "grimoires", ".run")
+DEFAULT_PATHS = "tools,evals/harness,evals/graders,tests/unit,evals/tests"
+SUBJECT = {"bugfix": re.compile(r"^(fix|bug)"), "refactor": re.compile(r"^(refactor|chore|style|perf)")}
+TYPE = {"bugfix": "bug-fix", "refactor": "refactor"}
+ID_PREFIX = {"bugfix": "bugfix", "refactor": "refactor"}
+INFRA_ROOT_FILES = ("pytest.ini", "pyproject.toml", "setup.cfg", "tox.ini")
+CUTOFF = "2026-08-01"
+RUN_TIMEOUT = 120
+MAX_COVERING_TESTS = 20
+
+
+class Usage(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def out(line):
+    print(line, flush=True)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- git helpers
+def git(repo, *args, binary=False):
+    cmd = ["git", "-C", repo, "-c", "core.quotepath=off", "-c", "diff.noprefix=false", *args]
+    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, env=_git_env())
+    if p.returncode != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"git {' '.join(args[:2])} failed: {p.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace').strip()}")
+    return p.stdout if binary else p.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")
+
+
+def _git_env():
+    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k in ("PATH", "HOME", "LANG", "TMPDIR")}
+    env.update({"LC_ALL": "C", "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1", "GIT_PAGER": "cat", "GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF": ""})
+    return env
+
+
+def safe_path(p):
+    """A history path we are willing to write: relative, no `..`, printable, no backslash."""
+    return bool(p) and not p.startswith("/") and ".." not in p.split("/") and "\\" not in p \
+        and all(c.isprintable() for c in p)
+
+
+def mount_owned(p):
+    return any(part in MOUNT_OWNED for part in p.split("/"))
+
+
+def is_test(p):
+    parts = p.split("/")
+    base = parts[-1]
+    return "tests" in parts[:-1] or re.fullmatch(r"test_.*\.py|.*_test\.py", base) is not None or base.endswith(".bats")
+
+
+def runner_of(p):
+    if p.endswith(".bats"):
+        return "bats"
+    if p.endswith(".py") and re.fullmatch(r"test_.*\.py|.*_test\.py", p.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]):
+        return "pytest"
+    return None
+
+
+def under_roots(p, roots):
+    return any(p == r or p.startswith(r + "/") for r in roots)
+
+
+def commits_since(repo, since):
+    raw = git(repo, "log", f"--since={since}", "--no-merges", "--format=%H%x1f%P%x1f%cs%x1f%s%x1e")
+    for rec in raw.split("\x1e"):
+        rec = rec.strip("\n")
+        if not rec:
+            continue
+        sha, parents, date, subject = (rec.split("\x1f") + ["", "", ""])[:4]
+        yield sha, parents.split(), date, subject
+
+
+def changed_files(repo, parent, sha):
+    raw = git(repo, "diff", "--no-renames", "--name-status", "-z", parent, sha)
+    items = raw.split("\0")
+    files = []
+    i = 0
+    while i + 1 < len(items):
+        status, path = items[i], items[i + 1]
+        files.append((status[:1], path))
+        i += 2
+    return files
+
+
+def numstat(repo, parent, sha, paths=None):
+    args = ["diff", "--no-renames", "--numstat", parent, sha]
+    if paths:
+        args += ["--", *paths]
+    rows = []
+    for line in git(repo, *args).splitlines():
+        a, d, p = line.split("\t", 2)
+        rows.append((a, d, p))
+    return rows
+
+
+def blob(repo, commit, path):
+    """(mode, bytes) of path at commit, or None when absent."""
+    ls = git(repo, "ls-tree", "-z", commit, "--", path).split("\0")[0]
+    if not ls:
+        return None
+    meta, _ = ls.split("\t", 1)
+    mode, kind, obj = meta.split()
+    if kind != "blob":
+        return None
+    return mode, git(repo, "cat-file", "blob", obj, binary=True)
+
+
+def tree_files(repo, commit, prefix=None):
+    args = ["ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--name-only", commit]
+    if prefix:
+        args += ["--", prefix]
+    return [p for p in git(repo, *args).split("\0") if p]
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- materialise
+def write_file(root, rel, data):
+    if not safe_path(rel):
+        raise ValueError(f"unsafe path: {rel!r}")
+    dest = os.path.join(root, rel)
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest), exist_ok=True)
+    with open(dest, "wb") as fh:
+        fh.write(data)
+
+
+def put_from(repo, commit, rel, root, dest_rel=None):
+    b = blob(repo, commit, rel)
+    if b is None:
+        return False
+    mode, data = b
+    if mode == "120000":
+        raise ValueError(f"symlink in history: {rel}")
+    write_file(root, dest_rel or rel, data)
+    return True
+
+
+def helper_files(repo, commit, test_paths):
+    """Test infrastructure the tests rely on: conftest.py up to the root, helpers in each test dir, root runner configs."""
+    have = set(tree_files(repo, commit))
+    found = set()
+    for t in test_paths:
+        d = os.path.dirname(t)
+        parts = d.split("/") if d else []
+        for i in range(len(parts) + 1):
+            c = "/".join(parts[:i] + ["conftest.py"])
+            if c in have:
+                found.add(c)
+        for f in have:
+            if os.path.dirname(f) == d and f not in test_paths:
+                base = os.path.basename(f)
+                if base in ("conftest.py", "__init__.py") or base.endswith(".bash") or "helper" in base:
+                    found.add(f)
+    for f in INFRA_ROOT_FILES:
+        if f in have:
+            found.add(f)
+    return sorted(found)
+
+
+def sibling_files(repo, commit, sources, roots, exclude):
+    """The other non-test files in each touched source file's directory (the modules it most likely imports)."""
+    dirs = {os.path.dirname(p) for p in sources}
+    out = []
+    for f in tree_files(repo, commit):
+        if os.path.dirname(f) in dirs and f not in exclude and not is_test(f) and safe_path(f) \
+                and not mount_owned(f) and under_roots(f, roots):
+            out.append(f)
+    return sorted(out)
+
+
+def counts(output, runner):
+    if runner == "bats":
+        passed = len(re.findall(r"^ok ", output, re.M))
+        failed = len(re.findall(r"^not ok ", output, re.M))
+        return passed, failed
+    tail = output.strip().splitlines()[-1] if output.strip() else ""
+    num = lambda w: sum(int(n) for n in re.findall(r"(\d+) " + w, tail))
+    return num("passed"), num("failed") + num("errors?")
+
+
+def run_tests(tree, cmd, runner):
+    """Run the task's test command under env -i (plus the host's user base so a user-site pytest is found)."""
+    home = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seed-home.")
+    env = {"PATH": os.environ.get("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin"), "HOME": home, "LC_ALL": "C",
+           "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1", "PYTHONUSERBASE": site.getuserbase()}
+    argv = list(cmd)
+    if runner == "pytest":
+        argv = argv[:3] + ["-p", "no:cacheprovider"] + argv[3:]
+    elif runner == "bats" and os.environ.get("LOA_SEED_BATS"):
+        argv[0] = os.environ["LOA_SEED_BATS"]
+    try:
+        p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=tree, env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=RUN_TIMEOUT)
+        text = (p.stdout + p.stderr).decode("utf-8", "replace")
+        rc = p.returncode
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        text, rc = "timeout", 124
+    except OSError as e:
+        text, rc = f"cannot run {argv[0]}: {e}", 127
+    finally:
+        shutil.rmtree(home, ignore_errors=True)
+    passed, failed = counts(text, runner)
+    return rc, passed, failed
+
+
+def apply_patch(tree, patch_file):
+    if shutil.which("patch"):
+        cmd = ["patch", "-s", "-p1", "--no-backup-if-mismatch", "-i", patch_file]
+    else:
+        cmd = ["git", "apply", "-p1", patch_file]
+    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=tree, capture_output=True).returncode == 0
+
+
+def overlay(task_dir, tree, manifest):
+    for e in manifest["files"]:
+        src = os.path.join(task_dir, "hidden", e["src"])
+        dest = os.path.join(tree, e["dest"])
+        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest), exist_ok=True)
+        shutil.copyfile(src, dest)
+
+
+def copy_tree(src, dest):
+    shutil.copytree(src, dest, symlinks=True)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- text
+def subject_rest(subject):
+    m = re.match(r"^[a-z]+(\([^)]*\))?!?:\s*(.*)$", subject)
+    return (m.group(2) if m else subject).strip()
+
+
+def sanitise(text, stems):
+    """Agent-facing text from a commit subject: no control characters, paths, file names, test names, grader words."""
+    text = "".join(c if c.isprintable() else " " for c in text)
+    words = []
+    for w in text.split():
+        if "/" in w or re.search(r"\.(py|sh|bats|js|ts|mjs|json|ya?ml|md|toml|cfg|ini|txt|patch)\b", w) \
+                or re.match(r"[\W]*test_\w+", w) or "hidden" in w.lower() \
+                or any(s and s.lower() in w.lower() for s in stems):
+            words.append("…")
+        else:
+            words.append(w)
+    return re.sub(r"(… ?)+", "… ", " ".join(words)).strip() or "the change"
+
+
+def yq(v):
+    return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False)
+
+
+def task_yaml(tid, mode, source, criterion, success, test_cmd, ref_patch, protected, suite_version):
+    src = "{" + ", ".join(f"{k}: {yq(v) if not isinstance(v, dict) else '{' + ', '.join(f'{a}: {b}' for a, b in v.items()) + '}'}"
+                          for k, v in source.items()) + "}"
+    lines = [
+        f"id: {tid}",
+        "schema_version: 1",
+        f"type: {TYPE[mode]}",
+        f"source: {src}",
+        f"post_cutoff: {'true' if source['date'] >= CUTOFF else 'false'}",
+        f"fixture: tasks/{tid}/fixture",
+        f"criterion: {yq(criterion)}",
+        f"success_criterion: {yq(success)}",
+        f"test_command: {yq(test_cmd)}",
+        "regression_command: null",
+        f"reference_patch: {ref_patch}",
+        f"grader_protected: {yq(protected)}",
+        "structural_check: null",
+        "bounds: {max_turns: {}, timeout_min: {}}",
+        "review_catch: null",
+        f"suite_version: {suite_version}",
+    ]
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- selection
+def classify(mode, repo, sha, parents, roots):
+    """('candidate', files) | ('refused', path) | ('skipped', reason)."""
+    if len(parents) != 1:
+        return "skipped", "not a single-parent commit"
+    files = changed_files(repo, parents[0], sha)
+    for _, p in files:
+        if not safe_path(p):
+            return "refused", "unsafe path " + json.dumps(p)
+    for _, p in files:
+        if mount_owned(p):
+            return "refused", p
+    for _, p in files:
+        if not under_roots(p, roots):
+            return "skipped", f"outside the allowed roots: {p}"
+    for a, d, p in numstat(repo, parents[0], sha):
+        if a == "-" or d == "-":
+            return "skipped", f"binary change: {p}"
+    tests = [p for _, p in files if is_test(p)]
+    sources = [p for _, p in files if not is_test(p)]
+    if mode == "bugfix":
+        if not tests:
+            return "skipped", "no test file touched"
+        if not sources:
+            return "skipped", "no source file touched"
+        added_or_modified = [p for s, p in files if is_test(p) and s in "AM"]
+        runners = {runner_of(p) for p in added_or_modified} - {None}
+        if not runners:
+            return "skipped", "no runnable test file (test_*.py, *_test.py, *.bats) added or changed"
+        if len(runners) > 1:
+            return "skipped", "mixed test runners (pytest and bats)"
+    else:
+        if tests:
+            return "skipped", f"touches a test file: {tests[0]}"
+        if len(sources) < 2:
+            return "skipped", f"touches {len(sources)} source file(s), want at least 2"
+    return "candidate", files
+
+
+def next_id(tasks_dir, prefix, taken):
+    n = 1
+    while True:
+        tid = f"{prefix}-{n:02d}"
+        if tid not in taken and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(tasks_dir, tid)):
+            taken.add(tid)
+            return tid
+        n += 1
+
+
+def covering_tests(repo, parent, sources, roots):
+    """Test files at parent (under the roots) that name a touched source file."""
+    names = set()
+    for s in sources:
+        base = os.path.basename(s)
+        names.add(base)
+        if base.endswith(".py"):
+            names.add(base[:-3])
+    pats = [re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" + re.escape(n) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])") for n in sorted(names)]
+    hits = []
+    for r in roots:
+        for f in tree_files(repo, parent, r):
+            if not is_test(f) or runner_of(f) is None or not safe_path(f) or mount_owned(f):
+                continue
+            b = blob(repo, parent, f)
+            if b is None or b[0] == "120000":
+                continue
+            text = b[1].decode("utf-8", "replace")
+            if any(p.search(text) for p in pats):
+                hits.append(f)
+    return sorted(set(hits))[:MAX_COVERING_TESTS]
+
+
+def test_dirs(paths):
+    return sorted({os.path.dirname(p) or "." for p in paths})
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- build one task
+def build_bugfix(repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, no_secrets, roots):
+    tdir = os.path.join(stage, tid)
+    fx = os.path.join(tdir, "fixture")
+    os.makedirs(fx)
+    tests_am = [p for s, p in files if is_test(p) and s in "AM"]
+    sources = [p for s, p in files if not is_test(p)]
+    runner = {runner_of(p) for p in tests_am} - {None}
+    runner = runner.pop()
+    for p in sources:
+        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)
+    for p in sibling_files(repo, parent, sources, roots, set(sources) | set(tests_am)):
+        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)
+    for p in tests_am:
+        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)          # the base version of a changed test (absent when added)
+    protected = [h for h in helper_files(repo, parent, tests_am) if h not in tests_am and h not in sources]
+    for h in protected:
+        put_from(repo, parent, h, fx)
+    hidden = os.path.join(tdir, "hidden")
+    manifest = {"files": []}
+    for p in tests_am:
+        put_from(repo, sha, p, hidden, "tests/" + p)
+        manifest["files"].append({"src": "tests/" + p, "dest": p})
+    write_file(hidden, "manifest.json", (json.dumps(manifest) + "\n").encode())
+    diff = git(repo, "diff", "--no-color", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-renames", "--src-prefix=a/", "--dst-prefix=b/",
+               parent, sha, "--", *sources, binary=True)
+    write_file(hidden, "reference.patch", diff)
+    runnable = [p for p in tests_am if runner_of(p)]
+    test_cmd = (["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q"] if runner == "pytest" else ["bats"]) + test_dirs(runnable)
+
+    # proof: red at base, green at reference (hidden tests overlaid on both)
+    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seed-proof.")
+    try:
+        base, ref = os.path.join(work, "base"), os.path.join(work, "ref")
+        copy_tree(fx, base)
+        overlay(tdir, base, manifest)
+        rc_b, pass_b, fail_b = run_tests(base, test_cmd, runner)
+        copy_tree(fx, ref)
+        if not apply_patch(ref, os.path.join(hidden, "reference.patch")):
+            return None, "the reference patch does not apply to the fixture"
+        overlay(tdir, ref, manifest)
+        rc_r, pass_r, fail_r = run_tests(ref, test_cmd, runner)
+    finally:
+        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
+    if rc_b == 0 or fail_b < 1:
+        return None, f"not red at base (exit {rc_b}, {fail_b} failed, {pass_b} passed)"
+    if rc_r != 0 or fail_r > 0 or pass_r < 1:
+        return None, f"not green at reference (exit {rc_r}, {fail_r} failed, {pass_r} passed)"
+    proof = f"red {fail_b} failed / green {pass_r} passed"
+
+    stems = [os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(p))[0] for p in tests_am]
+    rest = sanitise(subject_rest(subject), stems)
+    criterion = f"the behaviour this change describes holds: {rest}; the checks for it pass and the existing behaviour is unchanged"
+    hidden_list = ", ".join("hidden/tests/" + p for p in runnable)
+    success = (f"{hidden_list} (overlaid at {', '.join(runnable)}) passes {pass_r} of {pass_r} under {' '.join(test_cmd)}; "
+               f"red at base ({fail_b} failed), green with hidden/reference.patch")
+    source = {"kind": "loa-history", "fix_commit": sha, "base_commit": parent, "date": date}
+    write_file(tdir, "task.yaml", task_yaml(tid, "bugfix", source, criterion, success, test_cmd,
+                                           "hidden/reference.patch", protected, SUITE_VERSION).encode())
+    task_md = (f"# Task: {rest}\n\n"
+               f"**Bug (observed):** with the code as it is, {fail_b} of {fail_b + pass_b} checks for this behaviour fail "
+               f"when the test command below runs.\n\n"
+               f"**Expected:** {rest}. Every check passes and behaviour elsewhere is unchanged.\n\n"
+               f"Fix the bug in place and add a regression test of your own. Run the tests with `{' '.join(test_cmd)}`.\n")
+    write_file(tdir, "TASK.md", task_md.encode())
+    if not secrets_clean(no_secrets, tdir):
+        return "secret", "a secret pattern in the materialised task"
+    return tdir, proof
+
+
+def build_refactor(repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, no_secrets, roots):
+    sources = [p for s, p in files if not is_test(p)]
+    tests = covering_tests(repo, parent, sources, roots)
+    runners = {runner_of(t) for t in tests}
+    if not tests:
+        return "skip", "no test at the parent names a touched file"
+    if len(runners) > 1:
+        return "skip", "the covering tests mix pytest and bats"
+    runner = runners.pop()
+    tdir = os.path.join(stage, tid)
+    fx = os.path.join(tdir, "fixture")
+    os.makedirs(fx)
+    for p in sources:
+        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)
+    for p in sibling_files(repo, parent, sources, roots, set(sources) | set(tests)):
+        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)
+    for t in tests:
+        put_from(repo, parent, t, fx)
+    protected = [h for h in helper_files(repo, parent, tests) if h not in tests and h not in sources]
+    for h in protected:
+        put_from(repo, parent, h, fx)
+    hidden = os.path.join(tdir, "hidden")
+    diff = git(repo, "diff", "--no-color", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-renames", "--src-prefix=a/", "--dst-prefix=b/",
+               parent, sha, binary=True)
+    write_file(hidden, "reference.patch", diff)
+    write_file(hidden, "manifest.json", b'{"files": []}\n')
+    test_cmd = (["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q"] if runner == "pytest" else ["bats"]) + test_dirs(tests)
+
+    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seed-proof.")
+    try:
+        base, ref = os.path.join(work, "base"), os.path.join(work, "ref")
+        copy_tree(fx, base)
+        rc_b, pass_b, fail_b = run_tests(base, test_cmd, runner)
+        copy_tree(fx, ref)
+        if not apply_patch(ref, os.path.join(hidden, "reference.patch")):
+            return None, "the reference patch does not apply to the fixture"
+        rc_r, pass_r, fail_r = run_tests(ref, test_cmd, runner)
+    finally:
+        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
+    if rc_b != 0 or fail_b > 0 or pass_b < 1:
+        return None, f"suite not green at base (exit {rc_b}, {fail_b} failed, {pass_b} passed)"
+    if rc_r != 0 or fail_r > 0 or pass_r < 1:
+        return None, f"suite not green at reference (exit {rc_r}, {fail_r} failed, {pass_r} passed)"
+    proof = f"green at base ({pass_b} passed) / green at reference ({pass_r} passed)"
+
+    rows = numstat(repo, parent, sha)
+    churn = {"files": len(rows), "insertions": sum(int(a) for a, _, _ in rows), "deletions": sum(int(d) for _, d, _ in rows)}
+    rest = sanitise(subject_rest(subject), [])

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# seed-bugfix-tasks.sh — cycle-130 bug-fix task seeder (SDD §5.14, Sprint 259 Task 2.2)
#
# Turns Loa fix commits into candidate bug-fix tasks for the ablation suite.
# Lists the commits since DATE whose subject starts with `fix` or `bug`, whose
# diff touched a test file (a path under a `tests/` directory, `test_*.py`,
# `*_test.py` or `*.bats`) and whose touched files all lie under the allowed
# roots; refuses by name any candidate touching .claude/, CLAUDE.md,
# .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/ or .run/ (a path component equal to one of
# those). For each selected candidate (the first N, newest first) it writes
# <out>/tasks/bugfix-NN/ (next free number):
#   fixture/    from the PARENT commit: the touched non-test files, the other
#               non-test files in their directories (the modules they most
#               likely use), the base version of each changed test, and the
#               test infrastructure the tests rely on (conftest.py up to the
#               root, __init__.py, *.bash and *helper* files beside each test,
#               root pytest.ini / pyproject.toml / setup.cfg / tox.ini) — a
#               plain tree, no .git
#   hidden/     tests/<path> = each added or changed test at the commit,
#               manifest.json {"files":[{src, dest}]}, reference.patch = the
#               commit's diff of the non-test files (a/ b/ prefixes, patch -p1)
#   task.yaml   source {kind: loa-history, fix_commit, base_commit, date};
#               grader_protected = the infrastructure files; regression_command
#               null; test_command = python3 -m pytest -q <test dirs> | bats <test dirs>
#   TASK.md     the subject line, the observed failure count, the test command;
#               never the diff, never a test name (the subject is sanitised:
#               no paths, file names, test names or the word for grader files)
# A task is built in a private temporary directory and moved into place only
# after its proof passed: the test command, with the hidden tests overlaid, is
# red at base and green with the reference patch, run on the host under
# `env -i PATH HOME=<fresh tmp> LC_ALL=C` plus PYTHONUSERBASE (the host's user
# base, so a user-site pytest is found) and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, and
# evals/graders/no-secrets.sh passes on the whole task directory (a hit is a
# refusal). The selecting lead still rewrites TASK.md's observed behaviour and
# the criterion by hand before a task is frozen.
#
# Usage:
#   seed-bugfix-tasks.sh --since DATE [--select N] --out DIR [--repo DIR]
#                        [--paths CSV] [--suite-version N] [--dry-run]
#
#   --since DATE       YYYY-MM-DD; commits whose committer date is on or after it
#   --select N         tasks to materialise (default 4); refusals and skips do not
#                      count, a failed proof does
#   --out DIR          suite root; tasks go to DIR/tasks/<id>/
#   --repo DIR         git repository to read (default: this checkout)
#   --paths CSV        allowed roots (default tools,evals/harness,evals/graders,
#                      tests/unit,evals/tests); a mount-owned root is refused
#   --suite-version N  suite_version written to task.yaml (default 1)
#   --dry-run          list candidates, refusals and skips; write nothing
#   LOA_SEED_BATS      bats binary used for the proof when bats is not on PATH
#
# Output (stdout, one line each):
#   candidate <sha12> <date> <subject>
#   refused <sha12>: <path>                 (or: a secret pattern in the materialised task)
#   skipped <sha12>: <reason>
#   proof bugfix-NN <sha12>: red N failed / green M passed
#   proof-failed <sha12>: <reason>
#   wrote <dir>
#   seed-bugfix: C candidate(s), R refused, S skipped; selected X, written W, proof failed F
#
# Exit: 0 done (also when nothing qualified); 1 a selected candidate failed its
#       proof; 2 usage (bad option or date, not a git repository, bad --paths).
# Tested by evals/tests/seed-bugfix.bats.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed '1d;$d' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit "${1:-2}"; }
for a in "$@"; do [[ "$a" == "--help" || "$a" == "-h" ]] && usage 0; done
[[ $# -gt 0 ]] || usage 2
for tool in git python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "seed-bugfix: missing tool: $tool" >&2; exit 2; }; done

exec python3 -I "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/seed_tasks.py" bugfix --repo-default "$REPO_ROOT" \
  --no-secrets "$REPO_ROOT/evals/graders/no-secrets.sh" "$@"

#   TASK.md     the subject line and the test command; never the diff

#   proof-failed <sha12>: <reason>
#   wrote <dir>
#   seed-refactor: C candidate(s), R refused, S skipped; selected X, written W, proof failed F
#
# Exit: 0 done; 1 a selected candidate failed its proof; 2 usage.
# Tested by evals/tests/seed-refactor.bats.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"

usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed '1d;$d' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit "${1:-2}"; }
for a in "$@"; do [[ "$a" == "--help" || "$a" == "-h" ]] && usage 0; done
[[ $# -gt 0 ]] || usage 2
for tool in git python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "seed-refactor: missing tool: $tool" >&2; exit 2; }; done

exec python3 -I "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/seed_tasks.py" refactor --repo-default "$REPO_ROOT" \
  --no-secrets "$REPO_ROOT/evals/graders/no-secrets.sh" "$@"

def next_id(tasks_dir, prefix, taken):
    n = 1
    while True:
        tid = f"{prefix}-{n:02d}"
        if tid not in taken and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(tasks_dir, tid)):
            taken.add(tid)
            return tid
        n += 1


def covering_tests(repo, parent, sources, roots):
    """Test files at parent (under the roots) that name a touched source file."""
    names = set()
    for s in sources:
        base = os.path.basename(s)
        names.add(base)
        if base.endswith(".py"):
            names.add(base[:-3])
    pats = [re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" + re.escape(n) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])") for n in sorted(names)]
    hits = []
    for r in roots:
        for f in tree_files(repo, parent, r):
            if not is_test(f) or runner_of(f) is None or not safe_path(f) or mount_owned(f):
                continue
            b = blob(repo, parent, f)
            if b is None or b[0] == "120000":
                continue
            text = b[1].decode("utf-8", "replace")
            if any(p.search(text) for p in pats):
                hits.append(f)
    return sorted(set(hits))[:MAX_COVERING_TESTS]


def test_dirs(paths):
    return sorted({os.path.dirname(p) or "." for p in paths})


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- build one task
def build_bugfix(repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, no_secrets, roots):
    tdir = os.path.join(stage, tid)
    fx = os.path.join(tdir, "fixture")
    os.makedirs(fx)
    tests_am = [p for s, p in files if is_test(p) and s in "AM"]
    sources = [p for s, p in files if not is_test(p)]
    runner = {runner_of(p) for p in tests_am} - {None}
    runner = runner.pop()
    for p in sources:
        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)
    for p in sibling_files(repo, parent, sources, roots, set(sources) | set(tests_am)):
        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)
    for p in tests_am:
        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)          # the base version of a changed test (absent when added)
    protected = [h for h in helper_files(repo, parent, tests_am) if h not in tests_am and h not in sources]
    for h in protected:
        put_from(repo, parent, h, fx)
    hidden = os.path.join(tdir, "hidden")
    manifest = {"files": []}
    for p in tests_am:
        put_from(repo, sha, p, hidden, "tests/" + p)
        manifest["files"].append({"src": "tests/" + p, "dest": p})
    write_file(hidden, "manifest.json", (json.dumps(manifest) + "\n").encode())
    diff = git(repo, "diff", "--no-color", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-renames", "--src-prefix=a/", "--dst-prefix=b/",
               parent, sha, "--", *sources, binary=True)
    write_file(hidden, "reference.patch", diff)
    runnable = [p for p in tests_am if runner_of(p)]
    test_cmd = (["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q"] if runner == "pytest" else ["bats"]) + test_dirs(runnable)

    # proof: red at base, green at reference (hidden tests overlaid on both)
    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seed-proof.")
    try:
        base, ref = os.path.join(work, "base"), os.path.join(work, "ref")
        copy_tree(fx, base)
        overlay(tdir, base, manifest)
        rc_b, pass_b, fail_b = run_tests(base, test_cmd, runner)
        copy_tree(fx, ref)
        if not apply_patch(ref, os.path.join(hidden, "reference.patch")):
            return None, "the reference patch does not apply to the fixture"
        overlay(tdir, ref, manifest)
        rc_r, pass_r, fail_r = run_tests(ref, test_cmd, runner)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    if rc_b == 0 or fail_b < 1:
        return None, f"not red at base (exit {rc_b}, {fail_b} failed, {pass_b} passed)"
    if rc_r != 0 or fail_r > 0 or pass_r < 1:
        return None, f"not green at reference (exit {rc_r}, {fail_r} failed, {pass_r} passed)"
    proof = f"red {fail_b} failed / green {pass_r} passed"

    stems = [os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(p))[0] for p in tests_am]
    rest = sanitise(subject_rest(subject), stems)
    criterion = f"the behaviour this change describes holds: {rest}; the checks for it pass and the existing behaviour is unchanged"
    hidden_list = ", ".join("hidden/tests/" + p for p in runnable)
    success = (f"{hidden_list} (overlaid at {', '.join(runnable)}) passes {pass_r} of {pass_r} under {' '.join(test_cmd)}; "
               f"red at base ({fail_b} failed), green with hidden/reference.patch")
    source = {"kind": "loa-history", "fix_commit": sha, "base_commit": parent, "date": date}
    write_file(tdir, "task.yaml", task_yaml(tid, "bugfix", source, criterion, success, test_cmd,
                                           "hidden/reference.patch", protected, SUITE_VERSION).encode())
    task_md = (f"# Task: {rest}\n\n"
               f"**Bug (observed):** with the code as it is, {fail_b} of {fail_b + pass_b} checks for this behaviour fail "
               f"when the test command below runs.\n\n"
               f"**Expected:** {rest}. Every check passes and behaviour elsewhere is unchanged.\n\n"
               f"Fix the bug in place and add a regression test of your own. Run the tests with `{' '.join(test_cmd)}`.\n")
    write_file(tdir, "TASK.md", task_md.encode())
    if not secrets_clean(no_secrets, tdir):
        return "secret", "a secret pattern in the materialised task"
    return tdir, proof


def build_refactor(repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, no_secrets, roots):
    sources = [p for s, p in files if not is_test(p)]
    tests = covering_tests(repo, parent, sources, roots)
    runners = {runner_of(t) for t in tests}
    if not tests:
        return "skip", "no test at the parent names a touched file"
    if len(runners) > 1:
        return "skip", "the covering tests mix pytest and bats"
    runner = runners.pop()
    tdir = os.path.join(stage, tid)
    fx = os.path.join(tdir, "fixture")
    os.makedirs(fx)
    for p in sources:
        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)
    for p in sibling_files(repo, parent, sources, roots, set(sources) | set(tests)):
        put_from(repo, parent, p, fx)
    for t in tests:
        put_from(repo, parent, t, fx)
    protected = [h for h in helper_files(repo, parent, tests) if h not in tests and h not in sources]
    for h in protected:
        put_from(repo, parent, h, fx)
    hidden = os.path.join(tdir, "hidden")
    diff = git(repo, "diff", "--no-color", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-renames", "--src-prefix=a/", "--dst-prefix=b/",
               parent, sha, binary=True)
    write_file(hidden, "reference.patch", diff)
    write_file(hidden, "manifest.json", b'{"files": []}\n')
    test_cmd = (["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q"] if runner == "pytest" else ["bats"]) + test_dirs(tests)

    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seed-proof.")
    try:
        base, ref = os.path.join(work, "base"), os.path.join(work, "ref")
        copy_tree(fx, base)
        rc_b, pass_b, fail_b = run_tests(base, test_cmd, runner)
        copy_tree(fx, ref)
        if not apply_patch(ref, os.path.join(hidden, "reference.patch")):
            return None, "the reference patch does not apply to the fixture"
        rc_r, pass_r, fail_r = run_tests(ref, test_cmd, runner)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    if rc_b != 0 or fail_b > 0 or pass_b < 1:
        return None, f"suite not green at base (exit {rc_b}, {fail_b} failed, {pass_b} passed)"
    if rc_r != 0 or fail_r > 0 or pass_r < 1:
        return None, f"suite not green at reference (exit {rc_r}, {fail_r} failed, {pass_r} passed)"
    proof = f"green at base ({pass_b} passed) / green at reference ({pass_r} passed)"

    rows = numstat(repo, parent, sha)
    churn = {"files": len(rows), "insertions": sum(int(a) for a, _, _ in rows), "deletions": sum(int(d) for _, d, _ in rows)}
    rest = sanitise(subject_rest(subject), [])
    criterion = f"the structure this change describes is in place: {rest}; the existing suite stays green without edits"
    success = (f"structural check (to be authored under hidden/structural/) red at base and green with hidden/reference.patch; "
               f"{' '.join(test_cmd)} passes {pass_b} of {pass_b} at base and {pass_r} of {pass_r} at reference")
    source = {"kind": "loa-history", "fix_commit": sha, "base_commit": parent, "date": date, "churn": churn}
    write_file(tdir, "task.yaml", task_yaml(tid, "refactor", source, criterion, success, test_cmd,
                                           "hidden/reference.patch", protected, SUITE_VERSION).encode())
    task_md = (f"# Task: {rest}\n\n"
               f"**Refactor:** {rest}.\n\n"
               f"**Unchanged behaviour:** the existing suite must stay green without edits. Run it with `{' '.join(test_cmd)}`.\n")
    write_file(tdir, "TASK.md", task_md.encode())
    if not secrets_clean(no_secrets, tdir):
        return "secret", "a secret pattern in the materialised task"
    return tdir, proof + "\t" + json.dumps(churn)


def secrets_clean(no_secrets, tdir):
    if not no_secrets:
        return True
    p = subprocess.run(["bash", no_secrets, tdir], capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode == 0

SUITE_VERSION = 1


def parse(argv):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="seed-tasks", add_help=False)
    ap.add_argument("mode", choices=("bugfix", "refactor"))
    ap.add_argument("--repo-default", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--no-secrets", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--since", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--select", type=int, default=4)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--repo")
    ap.add_argument("--paths", default=DEFAULT_PATHS)
    ap.add_argument("--suite-version", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    try:
        a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    except SystemExit:
        raise Usage("bad arguments (see --help)")
    try:
        datetime.date.fromisoformat(a.since)
    except ValueError:
        raise Usage(f"--since must be YYYY-MM-DD, got {a.since!r}")
    if a.select < 1:
        raise Usage("--select must be at least 1")
    if a.suite_version < 1:
        raise Usage("--suite-version must be at least 1")
    a.repo = a.repo or a.repo_default
    if subprocess.run(["git", "-C", a.repo, "rev-parse", "--git-dir"], capture_output=True).returncode != 0:
        raise Usage(f"not a git repository: {a.repo}")
    roots = [r.strip().strip("/") for r in a.paths.split(",") if r.strip().strip("/")]
    if not roots or any(not safe_path(r) or mount_owned(r) for r in roots):
        raise Usage(f"--paths must be relative roots outside the mount-owned paths: {a.paths!r}")
    a.roots = roots
    return a


def main(argv):
    global SUITE_VERSION
    try:
        a = parse(argv)
    except Usage as e:
        print(f"seed-{a_mode(argv)}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    SUITE_VERSION = a.suite_version
    name = f"seed-{a.mode}"
    cands, refused, skipped = [], 0, 0
    for sha, parents, date, subject in commits_since(a.repo, a.since):
        if not SUBJECT[a.mode].match(subject):
            continue
        verdict, detail = classify(a.mode, a.repo, sha, parents, a.roots)
        if verdict == "refused":
            refused += 1
            out(f"refused {sha[:12]}: {detail}")
        elif verdict == "skipped":
            skipped += 1
            out(f"skipped {sha[:12]}: {detail}")
        else:
            cands.append((sha, parents[0], date, subject, detail))
            out(f"candidate {sha[:12]} {date} {''.join(c if c.isprintable() else ' ' for c in subject)}")
    selected = cands[: a.select]
    if a.dry_run:
        out(f"{name}: {len(cands)} candidate(s), {refused} refused, {skipped} skipped; dry run, nothing written")
        return 0
    tasks_dir = os.path.join(a.out, "tasks")
    stage = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seed-stage.")
    written = failed = 0
    taken = set()
    try:
        for sha, parent, date, subject, files in selected:
            tid = next_id(tasks_dir, ID_PREFIX[a.mode], taken)
            try:
                if a.mode == "bugfix":
                    tdir, info = build_bugfix(a.repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, a.no_secrets, a.roots)
                else:
                    tdir, info = build_refactor(a.repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, a.no_secrets, a.roots)
            except (ValueError, RuntimeError, OSError) as e:
                tdir, info = None, str(e)
            if tdir == "secret":
                refused += 1
                out(f"refused {sha[:12]}: {info}")
                taken.discard(tid)
                continue
            if tdir == "skip":
                skipped += 1
                out(f"skipped {sha[:12]}: {info}")
                taken.discard(tid)
                continue
            if tdir is None:
                failed += 1
                out(f"proof-failed {sha[:12]}: {info}")
                taken.discard(tid)
                continue
            os.makedirs(tasks_dir, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.move(tdir, os.path.join(tasks_dir, tid))
            written += 1
            if a.mode == "bugfix":
                out(f"proof {tid} {sha[:12]}: {info}")
            else:
                proof, churn = info.split("\t")
                c = json.loads(churn)
                out(f"proof {tid} {sha[:12]}: {proof}")
                out(f"churn {tid}: files {c['files']}, insertions {c['insertions']}, deletions {c['deletions']}")
                out(f"todo {tid}: author the structural check under hidden/structural/, list it in hidden/manifest.json "
                    f"and set structural_check (validate-suite.sh requires it for refactor)")
            out(f"wrote {os.path.join(tasks_dir, tid)}")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
    out(f"{name}: {len(cands)} candidate(s), {refused} refused, {skipped} skipped; "
        f"selected {len(selected)}, written {written}, proof failed {failed}")
    return 1 if failed else 0


def a_mode(argv):
    return argv[0] if argv and argv[0] in ("bugfix", "refactor") else "tasks"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

    p = subprocess.run(["bash", no_secrets, tdir], capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode == 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main
SUITE_VERSION = 1


def parse(argv):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="seed-tasks", add_help=False)
    ap.add_argument("mode", choices=("bugfix", "refactor"))
    ap.add_argument("--repo-default", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--no-secrets", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--since", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--select", type=int, default=4)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--repo")
    ap.add_argument("--paths", default=DEFAULT_PATHS)
    ap.add_argument("--suite-version", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    try:
        a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    except SystemExit:
        raise Usage("bad arguments (see --help)")
    try:
        datetime.date.fromisoformat(a.since)
    except ValueError:
        raise Usage(f"--since must be YYYY-MM-DD, got {a.since!r}")
    if a.select < 1:
        raise Usage("--select must be at least 1")
    if a.suite_version < 1:
        raise Usage("--suite-version must be at least 1")
    a.repo = a.repo or a.repo_default
    if subprocess.run(["git", "-C", a.repo, "rev-parse", "--git-dir"], capture_output=True).returncode != 0:
        raise Usage(f"not a git repository: {a.repo}")
    roots = [r.strip().strip("/") for r in a.paths.split(",") if r.strip().strip("/")]
    if not roots or any(not safe_path(r) or mount_owned(r) for r in roots):
        raise Usage(f"--paths must be relative roots outside the mount-owned paths: {a.paths!r}")
    a.roots = roots
    return a


def main(argv):
    global SUITE_VERSION
    try:
        a = parse(argv)
    except Usage as e:
        print(f"seed-{a_mode(argv)}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    SUITE_VERSION = a.suite_version
    name = f"seed-{a.mode}"
    cands, refused, skipped = [], 0, 0
    for sha, parents, date, subject in commits_since(a.repo, a.since):
        if not SUBJECT[a.mode].match(subject):
            continue
        verdict, detail = classify(a.mode, a.repo, sha, parents, a.roots)
        if verdict == "refused":
            refused += 1
            out(f"refused {sha[:12]}: {detail}")
        elif verdict == "skipped":
            skipped += 1
            out(f"skipped {sha[:12]}: {detail}")
        else:
            cands.append((sha, parents[0], date, subject, detail))
            out(f"candidate {sha[:12]} {date} {''.join(c if c.isprintable() else ' ' for c in subject)}")
    selected = cands[: a.select]
    if a.dry_run:
        out(f"{name}: {len(cands)} candidate(s), {refused} refused, {skipped} skipped; dry run, nothing written")
        return 0
    tasks_dir = os.path.join(a.out, "tasks")
    stage = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="seed-stage.")
    written = failed = 0
    taken = set()
    try:
        for sha, parent, date, subject, files in selected:
            tid = next_id(tasks_dir, ID_PREFIX[a.mode], taken)
            try:
                if a.mode == "bugfix":
                    tdir, info = build_bugfix(a.repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, a.no_secrets, a.roots)
                else:
                    tdir, info = build_refactor(a.repo, sha, parent, date, subject, files, tid, stage, a.no_secrets, a.roots)
            except (ValueError, RuntimeError, OSError) as e:
                tdir, info = None, str(e)
            if tdir == "secret":
                refused += 1
                out(f"refused {sha[:12]}: {info}")
                taken.discard(tid)
                continue
            if tdir == "skip":
                skipped += 1
                out(f"skipped {sha[:12]}: {info}")
                taken.discard(tid)
                continue
            if tdir is None:
                failed += 1
                out(f"proof-failed {sha[:12]}: {info}")
                taken.discard(tid)
                continue
            os.makedirs(tasks_dir, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.move(tdir, os.path.join(tasks_dir, tid))
            written += 1
            if a.mode == "bugfix":
                out(f"proof {tid} {sha[:12]}: {info}")
            else:
                proof, churn = info.split("\t")
                c = json.loads(churn)
                out(f"proof {tid} {sha[:12]}: {proof}")
                out(f"churn {tid}: files {c['files']}, insertions {c['insertions']}, deletions {c['deletions']}")
                out(f"todo {tid}: author the structural check under hidden/structural/, list it in hidden/manifest.json "
                    f"and set structural_check (validate-suite.sh requires it for refactor)")
            out(f"wrote {os.path.join(tasks_dir, tid)}")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
    out(f"{name}: {len(cands)} candidate(s), {refused} refused, {skipped} skipped; "
        f"selected {len(selected)}, written {written}, proof failed {failed}")
    return 1 if failed else 0


def a_mode(argv):
    return argv[0] if argv and argv[0] in ("bugfix", "refactor") else "tasks"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

#!/usr/bin/env bats

# sprint AC-2.9)
#
# seed-bugfix-tasks.sh over a throwaway git repo: a clean fix commit (a Python
# module + its test, red at the parent, green at the commit) becomes a task
# whose every field validates; a fix touching .claude/ is refused by name and
# writes nothing; --dry-run writes nothing; a fix whose test is already green
# at the parent fails its proof (exit 1, nothing written); a fix outside the
# allowed roots is skipped; usage errors are exit 2.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  SEED="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/seed-bugfix-tasks.sh"
  VS="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sb.XXXXXX")"
  G="$T/repo"; S="$T/suite"
  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"
  python3 -m pytest --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "pytest not importable by python3"
  git init -q -b main "$G"
  mkdir -p "$G/tools/mathx/tests" "$G/docs"
  cat > "$G/tools/mathx/rounding.py" <<'PY'
def round_half(x):
    """Round to the nearest integer, halves away from zero."""
    return int(x + 0.5)
PY
  cat > "$G/tools/mathx/tests/conftest.py" <<'PY'
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
PY
  cat > "$G/tools/mathx/tests/test_rounding.py" <<'PY'
from rounding import round_half

def test_positive():
    assert round_half(2.5) == 3
PY
  echo "notes" > "$G/docs/README"
  gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "chore: initial"
}

teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }

gc() { git -C "$G" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t -c commit.gpgsign=false "$@"; }

# the clean fix: negative halves round away from zero; two new test cases
commit_clean_fix() {
  cat > "$G/tools/mathx/rounding.py" <<'PY'
import math


def round_half(x):
    """Round to the nearest integer, halves away from zero."""
    return int(math.copysign(math.floor(abs(x) + 0.5), x))
PY
  cat >> "$G/tools/mathx/tests/test_rounding.py" <<'PY'

def test_negative_half():
    assert round_half(-2.5) == -3

def test_negative():
    assert round_half(-1.6) == -2
PY
  gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "fix(mathx): negative halves round away from zero"
}

commit_claude_fix() {
  mkdir -p "$G/.claude"
  echo 'echo hi' > "$G/.claude/x.sh"
  printf '\ndef test_again():\n    assert round_half(1.5) == 2\n' >> "$G/tools/mathx/tests/test_rounding.py"
  gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "fix: the framework hook"
}

@test "SB-1 a clean fix commit becomes a task: fixture from the parent, hidden tests from the commit, proof printed, validate-suite passes" {
  commit_clean_fix
  FIX="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD)"; BASE="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD~1)"
  run "$SEED" --since 2000-01-01 --select 4 --out "$S" --repo "$G"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q "^candidate ${FIX:0:12} " <<<"$output"
  grep -qx "proof bugfix-01 ${FIX:0:12}: red 2 failed / green 3 passed" <<<"$output"
  grep -q 'selected 1, written 1, proof failed 0' <<<"$output"

  # fixture = the parent's module, the base test, the conftest; nothing else, no history
  [ "$(cd "$D/fixture" && find . -type f | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = "./tools/mathx/rounding.py ./tools/mathx/tests/conftest.py ./tools/mathx/tests/test_rounding.py " ]

  [ "$(yq -o=json -I=0 .grader_protected "$D/task.yaml")" = '["tools/mathx/tests/conftest.py"]' ]
  [ "$(yq -r .reference_patch "$D/task.yaml")" = "hidden/reference.patch" ]

  # no stray staging dir, no caches
  [ -z "$(find "$S" -name __pycache__ -o -name .pytest_cache)" ]
}

  grep -q '^refused .*: .claude/x.sh$' <<<"$output"
  grep -q '1 candidate(s), 1 refused, 0 skipped; dry run, nothing written' <<<"$output"
  [ ! -e "$S" ]
}

@test "SB-4 a fix whose test is already green at the parent fails its proof: exit 1, nothing written" {
  printf '\ndef test_more():\n    assert round_half(0.2) == 0\n' >> "$G/tools/mathx/tests/test_rounding.py"
  echo '# comment' >> "$G/tools/mathx/rounding.py"
  gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "fix: a cosmetic change"
  run "$SEED" --since 2000-01-01 --out "$S" --repo "$G"
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  grep -q '^proof-failed .*: not red at base' <<<"$output"
  [ ! -e "$S/tasks" ]
}

@test "SB-5 a fix outside the allowed roots, one without a test and a non-fix subject are not candidates" {
  echo "more" >> "$G/docs/README"
  printf '\ndef test_docs():\n    assert True\n' >> "$G/tools/mathx/tests/test_rounding.py"
  gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "fix: docs and a test"
  DOCS="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD)"
  echo '# x' >> "$G/tools/mathx/rounding.py"; gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "fix: no test"
  NOTEST="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD)"
  echo '# y' >> "$G/tools/mathx/rounding.py"; gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "feat: not a fix"

  run "$SEED" --since 2000-01-01 --out "$S" --repo "$G" --dry-run --paths tools,docs
  grep -q "^candidate ${DOCS:0:12} " <<<"$output"
  run "$SEED" --since 2000-01-01 --out "$S" --repo "$G" --dry-run --paths tools,grimoires
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
}

@test "SB-6 usage: no arguments, a missing --since, a bad date, a non-repository are exit 2; --help is exit 0" {
  run "$SEED"
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  run "$SEED" --out "$S" --repo "$G"
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  run "$SEED" --since 2026-13-01 --out "$S" --repo "$G"
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  grep -q 'since must be YYYY-MM-DD' <<<"$output"
  run "$SEED" --since 2026-08-01 --out "$S" --repo "$T"
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  run "$SEED" --since 2026-08-01 --out "$S" --repo "$G" --select 0
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  run "$SEED" --help
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q 'Exit: 0 done' <<<"$output"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/seed-refactor.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 259 Task 2.3 (SDD §5.14,
# sprint AC-2.3, AC-2.9)
#
# seed-refactor-tasks.sh over a throwaway git repo: a refactor commit touching
# two source files with the tests unchanged and green becomes a task with the
# churn recorded (task.yaml source.churn and the printed churn line, equal to
# git diff --numstat), the suite green at both ends, the structural check left
# to author; a candidate touching a test file is skipped with the reason; one
# touching grimoires/ is refused by name; a one-file change is skipped;
# --dry-run writes nothing; a refactor that breaks the suite fails its proof.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  SEED="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/seed-refactor-tasks.sh"
  VS="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sr.XXXXXX")"
  G="$T/repo"; S="$T/suite"
  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"
  python3 -m pytest --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "pytest not importable by python3"
  git init -q -b main "$G"
  mkdir -p "$G/tools/fmt/tests"
  cat > "$G/tools/fmt/left.py" <<'PY'
def left(s, width):
    s = str(s)
    if len(s) >= width:
        return s
    return s + " " * (width - len(s))
PY
  cat > "$G/tools/fmt/right.py" <<'PY'
def right(s, width):
    s = str(s)
    if len(s) >= width:
        return s
    return " " * (width - len(s)) + s
PY
  cat > "$G/tools/fmt/tests/conftest.py" <<'PY'
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
PY
  cat > "$G/tools/fmt/tests/test_fmt.py" <<'PY'
from left import left
from right import right

def test_left():
    assert left("ab", 4) == "ab  "
    assert left("abcde", 4) == "abcde"

def test_right():
    assert right(7, 3) == "  7"
PY
  gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "chore: initial"
}

teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }

gc() { git -C "$G" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t -c commit.gpgsign=false "$@"; }

commit_refactor() {
  cat > "$G/tools/fmt/pad.py" <<'PY'
def gap(s, width):
    """The padding that brings str(s) up to width (empty when it is already wider)."""
    return " " * max(0, width - len(str(s)))
PY
  printf 'from pad import gap\n\n\ndef left(s, width):\n    return str(s) + gap(s, width)\n' > "$G/tools/fmt/left.py"
  printf 'from pad import gap\n\n\ndef right(s, width):\n    return gap(s, width) + str(s)\n' > "$G/tools/fmt/right.py"
  gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "refactor(fmt): share the padding helper"
}

@test "SR-1 a two-source refactor with unchanged green tests becomes a task with churn recorded and printed" {
  commit_refactor
  SHA="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD)"; BASE="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD~1)"
  read -r F I D < <(git -C "$G" diff --numstat "$BASE" "$SHA" | awk '{f++; i+=$1; d+=$2} END {print f, i, d}')
  run "$SEED" --since 2000-01-01 --out "$S" --repo "$G"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  grep -q "^candidate ${SHA:0:12} " <<<"$output"
  grep -qx "proof refactor-01 ${SHA:0:12}: green at base (2 passed) / green at reference (2 passed)" <<<"$output"
  grep -qx "churn refactor-01: files $F, insertions $I, deletions $D" <<<"$output"
  grep -q '^todo refactor-01: author the structural check' <<<"$output"
  K="$S/tasks/refactor-01"
  [ "$(yq -o=json -I=0 .source.churn "$K/task.yaml")" = "{\"files\":$F,\"insertions\":$I,\"deletions\":$D}" ]
  [ "$F" -eq 3 ]
  [ "$(yq -r .type "$K/task.yaml")" = "refactor" ]
  [ "$(yq -r .source.kind "$K/task.yaml")" = "loa-history" ]
  [ "$(yq -r .source.fix_commit "$K/task.yaml")" = "$SHA" ]
  [ "$(yq -r .source.base_commit "$K/task.yaml")" = "$BASE" ]
  [ "$(yq -r .structural_check "$K/task.yaml")" = "null" ]
  [ "$(yq -o=json -I=0 .test_command "$K/task.yaml")" = '["python3","-m","pytest","-q","tools/fmt/tests"]' ]
  [ "$(yq -o=json -I=0 .grader_protected "$K/task.yaml")" = '["tools/fmt/tests/conftest.py"]' ]
  # fixture = the parent's sources and the covering test, a plain tree; the reference patch applies to it
  [ "$(cd "$K/fixture" && find . -type f | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = "./tools/fmt/left.py ./tools/fmt/right.py ./tools/fmt/tests/conftest.py ./tools/fmt/tests/test_fmt.py " ]
  [ ! -e "$K/fixture/.git" ]

  [ -f "$T/applied/tools/fmt/pad.py" ]

  # the only violations validate-suite reports are the structural check still to author (and its manifest entry)
  run "$VS" --root "$S" --allow-partial
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  [ "$(grep -c '^tasks/' <<<"$output")" -eq 2 ]
  grep -qx 'tasks/refactor-01: schema: structural_check is required for refactor' <<<"$output"
  grep -qx 'tasks/refactor-01: hidden: manifest.json must be {"files": \[{src, dest}, ...\]}' <<<"$output"
}

  printf '\ndef test_more():\n    assert left("", 1) == " "\n' >> "$G/tools/fmt/tests/test_fmt.py"
  echo '# a' >> "$G/tools/fmt/left.py"; echo '# b' >> "$G/tools/fmt/right.py"

  ONE="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD)"
  mkdir -p "$G/grimoires/loa"; echo n > "$G/grimoires/loa/NOTES.md"
  echo '# d' >> "$G/tools/fmt/left.py"; echo '# e' >> "$G/tools/fmt/right.py"
